cases.reason: The owner document explicitly reserves these choices to deployment owners. A checker cannot select acceptable harm or constitute that decision.

cases.reason: The task is explicitly conditional on the pilot baseline. The owner document says field pilot and owner choices remain pending. No archived proposal or payload was retrieved.

decision: Do not expand generic agent integrations on this evidence; preserve existing consumers and seek future independently arising tasks without retroactively replacing this sample.
